save_user_info.doc: Reachability only - authentication is enforced in service/onboarding.js by _identity(), which rejects anonymous callers (ID_NOBODY) with 401 and keys every row on the caller's uid. Do NOT set src:owner here: onboarding requests carry no hub_id, so the ACL resolves them against the endpoint's own hub, and a user in onboarding never owns that hub - it denies every call with PERMISSION_DENIED. (contact.invite can use src:owner only because it passes hub_id: Visitor.id, i.e. the caller's own hub.)

save_signup_info.doc: Pre-auth signup step: by definition there is no user yet.
